action.objective: Verify d2d4: does the central advance hold against Black's queen and make d4 safe (Qxd4 refuted by Nxd4/Bxf7)?
action.rationale: Broad search suggested d2d4 with exact score 111 at depth 2, but only depth 2 completed and no verification ran. Black queen on c5 eyes c4 and the a7-g1 diagonal; d5 pawn and e5 pawn fight for d4. Single-candidate verification at full depth 4 checks whether Qxc4, Qxd4, or ...dxc4 tactics refute the advance and whether any mate-in-one exists.
